studio.name: Axis Architects
studio.tagline: We Design Spaces That Tell Stories.
studio.subTagline: 17+ years of architecture, interiors & urban design across Lucknow.
studio.shortAbout: Axis Architects is a Lucknow-based architecture and interior design firm with over 17 years of expertise. From luxury residences to corporate offices, our work reflects a deep commitment to design excellence, client trust, and timeless craft.
studio.philosophy: Lucknow's trusted design partner since 2005 — leaders in architecture & design delivering buildings that balance beauty, structure and function.

services.blurb: Custom designs that balance beauty, structure, and function.
